name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 2a – after sub§ 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: The additional free allocation resulting from the application of the first and second subparagraphs of this paragraph shall be covered exclusively by the quantities of allowances lawfully available for free allocation pursuant to Article 10a, paragraphs 5 and 5a. Allowances that have not yet been allocated may also be taken into account, provided that their use for this purpose is permitted under applicable Union law. Before determining the additional free allocation, the Commission shall identify the quantities of allowances available for this purpose, taking into account existing allocation entitlements. The regular auction volumes to which Member States are entitled pursuant to Article 10(2)(a) shall not be reduced, either directly or indirectly, by the application of this paragraph. The total quantity of allowances available under the EU Emissions Trading System shall remain unchanged.
